showcase: RakuWorld — the open NVIDIA GTC showcase for RakuAI

model.role: reasoning / control decisions; the model states its prediction before the engine runs and corrects from the measured error

serving.serving_hardware: not observed — no claim is made about the hardware NVIDIA serves the model on

result.task: apply an impulse so a ball comes to rest on a target; the compiled physics runtime measures where it actually stopped
result.method: iterative correction from the measured error, in-context; nothing trained between decisions
result.transport: in-process tool calls; this result is not an MCP-transport run (MCP is a separate, distinct capability of the runtime)

gpu_rendering.adapter: NVIDIA Quadro T2000 with Max-Q Design
gpu_rendering.how: the adapter is read back from the created ID3D11Device, not from the request
gpu_rendering.physics: CPU (the GPU renders; it computes no physics)

hashes.note: the two showcase frames are the runtime's own renders at the initial and final control error, taken from the public film

private_record.note: SHA-256 of the private measurement record (tool calls, intermediate measurements, model reasoning) from which the errors above are read; the record is not published
